excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

temporal_projection_rule.input: the immediately previous warm frame's exact option counts
temporal_projection_rule.clip: in catalogue order, retain at most each prior count subject to current visible queue resources and the lane cap
temporal_projection_rule.greedy_completion: while lanes remain, add the feasible single copy producing the best current score/duration/index key, only if that key improves
temporal_projection_rule.search_role: the projection initializes only the feasible incumbent lower bound; it does not alter roots, branching, or LP upper bounds
temporal_projection_rule.accounting: projection option probes and the extra incumbent candidate evaluation are reported in addition to native search work
temporal_projection_rule.online_information: previous exact option counts plus current released queue only

reference.family: the original cold count-space branch-and-bound selector
reference.accounting: actual reported work from one K4096 call per frame

protocol.arrival_model: independent class-wise Poisson arrivals using stream key aligned-frame:{seed}:{coordinate}
protocol.common_tape_rule: construct one tape for each (lanes, load, seed) and pass its exact contents to warm and cold K4096 runs
protocol.online_information: each selector receives only current released queues, lanes, fixed catalogue, and for warm search the previous exact warm count vector
protocol.dispatch: global synchronous frames, FIFO within class, with arrivals during a frame eligible at the next frame boundary
protocol.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at 600 seconds and drain the common finite tape to completion
registered_gate: warm and cold selections are exact in every visited frame
warm and cold K4096 frame actions are exactly identical
warm and cold per-job flow sequences are exactly identical
charged warm LP calls are strictly below cold in every case
charged warm matrix cells are strictly below cold in every case
both charged work totals are also strictly below reference in aggregate
all jobs complete and queue recursion, FIFO decomposition, and every attempt certificate are valid

expected_work.selector_calls: one warm and one cold call per visited frame
expected_work.projection_calls: one per warm frame after the first

decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more registered execution-integrity checks fail
decision_rule.TEMPORAL_INCUMBENT_PASS: every warm frame is exact and identical to the cold K4096 reference, and charged warm LP calls and matrix cells are strictly smaller in every R/load case and in aggregate
decision_rule.TEMPORAL_INCUMBENT_WORK_FAIL_STOP: execution is valid but one or more registered exactness, identity, or strict-work gates fail

protocol.claim_boundary: A registered finite-horizon development comparison on eight fresh Poisson seeds per load for synthetic identical-lane R8 and R16 models.  It tests a one-frame temporal incumbent on these tapes only; it is not an all-queue result, stability proof, physical multi-GPU measurement, or deployment decision.
protocol.prohibited: post-result changes to seeds, horizon, loads, projection, reference, or endpoints; ordered-action or count-vector enumeration; future-arrival access; paper or README edits

limitations: The finite seed roster cannot establish an all-queue guarantee.
Wall-clock selector timing is diagnostic and is not a scientific gate.
Every duration-root LP remains mandatory for warm and cold searches.
next_step: Preserve this registered outcome without changing seeds, projection, reference accounting, or gates.
